name: Dampier to Bunbury Pipeline
description: WA's principal gas transmission trunk line, running from the North West Shelf at Dampier south through Perth to Bunbury.

name: Parmelia Gas Pipeline
description: Parallel trunk line into the Perth/Kwinana metro area, historically a separate line from the DBP, now operating as part of the integrated WA network.

name: Goldfields Gas Pipeline
description: Carries Pilbara gas from Dampier south-east to the Goldfields mining region at Kalgoorlie.

name: Pilbara Pipeline System
description: Regional pipeline network distributing Pilbara gas between Dampier and Port Hedland.

name: Telfer Gas Pipeline
description: Lateral pipeline supplying the remote Telfer mine from the Pilbara network at Port Hedland.

name: Mid West Pipeline
description: Connects Geraldton and the Windimurra vanadium mine into the Dampier to Bunbury Pipeline network.

name: Eastern Goldfields Pipeline System
description: Extends gas supply beyond the Goldfields Gas Pipeline terminus at Kalgoorlie south to Kambalda and Esperance.

name: Northern Goldfields Interconnect Pipeline
description: Interconnect linking the Goldfields Gas Pipeline near Newman directly through to Kalgoorlie.

name: Kalgoorlie-Kambalda Pipeline
description: Short lateral linking Kalgoorlie to the Kambalda mining area.

name: Kambalda Esperance Gas Pipeline
description: Extends supply from Kambalda south to the port of Esperance.
